voibosTools.title: Voibos Tools
voibosTools.description: Voibos Geo Services (Elevation, Sun position, Profile, Travel time)

elevation.title: Elevation Service
elevation.description: Query point elevation above sea level by clicking on the map.
elevation.instruction: Click a point on the map to query the terrain elevation.
elevation.activeHint: Map query active: click anywhere on the map.
elevation.notInAustria: The selected coordinates are outside the coverage area (Austria).

sun.title: Sun Position
sun.description: Analyze sun position (elevation, azimuth, sunrise and sunset) for date and time.
sun.instruction: Select date and time and click 'Select location on map'.
sun.activeHint: Map query active: click on the map to choose a location.
sun.monthlyHeader: Average daily sunshine hours per month
sun.openInVoibosTooltip: View this query directly on the Voibos website
sun.notInAustria: The selected coordinates are outside the coverage area (Austria).

profile.title: Profile Service
profile.description: Create terrain elevation profiles along a drawn line.
profile.instruction: Click on the map to draw a profile line. Double-click to finish.
profile.drawingActive: Drawing active: Click on the map (double-click to finish).
profile.openInVoibosTooltip: View this elevation profile directly on the Voibos website
profile.errorFewPoints: The profile line requires at least 2 points.
profile.notInAustria: The drawn line is outside the coverage area (Austria).

routing.title: Travel Time Calculation
routing.description: Multi-point route, travel time and distance calculation for different travel modes.
